description: This file defines an abstract class 'DatabaseAbstract' for database-related calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including methods for extracting fields, filtering data, building queries, and processing conditions.

classes.name: DatabaseAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing static methods for database calculations, including evaluation, field extraction, filtering, query building, and condition processing.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate a database query based on criteria.

methods.name: fieldExtract
methods.description: Extracts the column index from a database range based on a column label or position.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters database rows based on specified criteria.

methods.name: getFilteredColumn
methods.description: Retrieves data from a specific column after filtering the database.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query string from criteria labels and values.

methods.name: buildCondition
methods.description: Builds a condition string for a criterion, handling wildcards and logical operators.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the constructed query against the database, filtering rows based on evaluation.

methods.name: processCondition
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in conditions with actual data values from a database row.
